dataset: MCP Registry daily supply delta — Tanod publisher snapshot
limitations: Dates are publisher's snapshot dates; retrieval via public publisher JSON on 2026-10-23.
These are registry listings and namespace labels, not verified unique businesses, paying customers, revenue, actual MCP calls or installed users.
The publisher's 2026-10-23 JSON has liveness=null; do not reuse the 2026-10-10 liveness cohort as if it were measured today.
Snapshots are not an independently reproduced full official-registry census; registry changes and publisher ingestion lag may affect daily deltas.
Publisher's namespace labels are not legal supplier identities; concentration is supply-listing concentration only.
Existing collector 100-page cap at 100 entries/page could not cover 49,036 names. Raised to 1,000 pages with a default 0.25s inter-page delay; a full crawl has NOT been executed.
